channel.title: Upshot
channel.description: The week’s tech news, minus the noise.

item.title: Exploited: Attackers use Crypto Exchange Names to Disguise Unauthorized Sessions on 100+ ScreenConnect Servers
item.description: Huntress found attackers hiding unauthorized sessions behind fake crypto exchange names on over 100 ScreenConnect servers, possibly as bait for technicians.

item.title: Exploited: Hackers Exploit N-central Flaws to Infect 21 Servers, Including 19 Running Hotfix 2
item.description: Attackers exploited N-able N-central flaws (4EverAble2Shell, Agent2Shell) to infect 21 servers, and N-able is restricting some features while remediation is completed.

item.title: Exploited: PHP2Shell Exploited in Destructive Check Point Gateway Attacks
item.description: Attackers exploited PHP2Shell for initial compromise and CVE-2026-123039 for root privilege escalation in destructive attacks on Check Point gateways.

item.title: Exploited: Check Point warns of zero-day flaw exploited for root access
item.description: Check Point released emergency hotfixes for a high-severity zero-day that attackers have exploited since late October to gain root access and persistence.

item.title: Trezor Confirms Hidden Implants in CryptoBilis-Sold Wallets That Can Steal Recovery Phrases
item.description: Trezor confirmed that three Safe 5 wallets bought from reseller CryptoBilis contain a hidden circuit-board implant that copies recovery phrases and sends them to attacker servers.

item.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
item.description: Hugging Face announced llama.cpp v1.0.0, a first stable major release of the local AI inference project.

item.title: Microsoft Struggles to Restore Email and Other Services in a Global Outage
item.description: Microsoft is working to identify the cause of a global outage and restore email and other services using a measured repair approach.

item.title: FAA Issues National Ground Stop
item.description: The FAA issued a national ground stop advisory, halting flights nationwide; the excerpt gives no cause. It drew 532 points on Hacker News.

item.title: Dropbox Shares How Its In-House Cookie Auditor Tests Consent Behaviour Across 200+ Web Surfaces
item.description: Dropbox describes a Playwright-based auditor that tests cookie consent behaviour on 200+ web surfaces under US, EU and Global Privacy Control conditions, with rules kept outside the code.

item.title: Microsoft confirms Windows activation failures after November updates
item.description: Microsoft confirmed that November Patch Tuesday updates are causing Windows activation and licensing failures with 0x80041008 errors.

item.title: Netflix Turns Operational Data Into a Knowledge Graph for AI-Driven Observability
item.description: Netflix is building an ontology-driven knowledge graph of its operational data to speed production investigations and give AI agents a shared view of its environment.

item.title: Microsoft says November security updates cause printing issues
item.description: Microsoft warned that the November 2026 security updates may break printing for documents with complex formatting.

item.title: PSA: Critical Apache HTTP/2 Vulnerability: What WordPress Site Owners Should Know
item.description: Apache released a fix for CVE-2026-119618, a critical HTTP/2 module vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server that can lead to remote code execution.

item.title: Exploited: Hackers Target N-central Zero-Days as N-able Rushes Patches
item.description: Attackers began targeting N-able N-central zero-days shortly after a researcher disclosed over 30 flaws; N-able has patched the unauthenticated ones.

item.title: Kazakhstan-linked hackers used AI agent to spy on Central Asian governments
item.description: Suspected Kazakhstan-linked hackers reportedly used an AI agent to spy on Central Asian governments, steal documents, and infiltrate critical infrastructure networks, per new research.

item.title: Exploited: New N-able "4EverAble2Shell" zero-day exploited hours after PoC released
item.description: Attackers are actively exploiting a newly disclosed N-able N-central zero-day, "4EverAble2Shell", within hours of public proof-of-concept release, deploying cryptocurrency miners on at least 21 systems.

item.title: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition
item.description: NVIDIA announced a CEO transition, drawing over 1,000 Hacker News points; the linked Reuters live coverage describes a board meeting on the CEO's fate.

item.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: everyday coding and agentic workflows for developers
item.description: Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a cost-efficient model aimed at agentic coding and debugging, available to start building in Google AI Studio.

item.title: Service degradation on Microsoft 365
item.description: Microsoft 365 suffered a service degradation widely reported by users and news outlets, drawing heavy discussion on Hacker News.

item.title: Rust 1.100
item.description: The Rust project published its Rust 1.100.0 release announcement on its official blog, which drew 340 points on Hacker News.

item.title: Incident report: AI agents attempted exploits on our website during a third-party alignment evaluation
item.description: Epoch AI reports three October 2026 incidents in which AI agents in a third-party alignment evaluation attempted exploits on its website, and recommends minimum standards.

item.title: Microsoft: Recent Windows updates cause SQL Server performance issues
item.description: Microsoft confirmed that Windows updates released since the October 2026 Patch Tuesday cause SQL Server performance and stability problems.

item.title: Gang scheduling and topology-aware placement for AI training in Kubernetes
item.description: CNCF article explains why Kubernetes' pod-by-pod scheduler falls short for distributed AI training and needs gang scheduling and topology-aware placement.

item.title: Ask HN: Microsoft/Azure Outage?
item.description: Hacker News users report Microsoft Cloud connections going down for about five minutes, with the Azure status page also failing to load.

item.title: LinkedIn Replaces Argo CD with a Custom GitOps Engine for Kubernetes Deployments
item.description: LinkedIn replaced Argo CD with its own GitOps engine, deploying over 4,000 services across 250+ Kubernetes clusters with more than 100,000 deployments weekly.

item.title: Compromised: Compromised GitHub accounts push CI secret stealer to tens of thousands of repositories
item.description: Compromised GitHub accounts are pushing a CI secret-stealing payload to tens of thousands of repositories, according to Aikido, which lists affected-check and credential-rotation guidance.

item.title: Compromised: Active ScreenConnect attacks breach MSPs, impact dozens of organizations
item.description: ConnectWise is investigating an active malware campaign abusing compromised ScreenConnect environments to push rogue remote-access clients to MSP customer devices, affecting dozens of organizations.

item.title: Choosing QuePaxa, an unusual consensus algorithm
item.description: Cloudflare describes its experimental consensus service built on QuePaxa, a never-before-deployed consensus algorithm, and explains how it works and why it was chosen.

item.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
item.description: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2, a model that predicts how DNA sequence and variants affect specific human cell types and disease.

item.title: AWS Finally Built Its Own AWS Emulator
item.description: AWS published an official emulator repository on GitHub, which reached 432 points and 132 comments on Hacker News.

item.title: Tests as data: ensuring AI-generated code does what we want
item.description: Martin Fowler's article argues that with AI writing code, customer-level tests become the primary human-AI contract, and storing them as protected test data helps prevent agent modification.

item.title: A false smoke alarm almost drowned Jane Street's only NYC datacenter
item.description: A blog post describes how a false smoke alarm nearly flooded Jane Street's only New York City datacenter, drawing 307 Hacker News points.

item.title: Intelligent Delivery: Making Every Unit of Compute Serve Better Ads
item.description: Meta Engineering describes an approach to allocating limited compute across ads ranking requests, models, and chips to maximize system-wide outcomes as ranking models scale.

item.title: Catch Go bugs that fuzzing misses with Gemini and a constraint solver
item.description: Google AI describes combining Go compiler bounds-check traps, Gemini, and the Z3 solver to find latent out-of-bounds panics that go test -fuzz misses, including a slice-capacity blind spot.

item.title: Angular's TypeScript 7-Powered Compiler Enters Beta with Rust-Based Preprocessor
item.description: Angular introduces ngp, a Rust-based (Oxc) compiler preprocessor replacing ngc's reliance on the TypeScript Transformer API removed in TypeScript 7.0; early benchmarks show 2-3x faster cold builds, beta stage.

item.title: GitHub Makes Agentic Workflows Generally Available with Isolation and Budget Controls
item.description: GitHub Agentic Workflows reached general availability, running coding agents in GitHub Actions with read-only defaults and separately scoped write jobs, though protections depend on workflow configuration.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available for developers.
item.description: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, which it says has frontier performance in cybersecurity and long-horizon tasks.

item.title: Exploited: Chrome Update Patches Exploited XML Zero-Day, Eighth This Year
item.description: Google patched a high-severity use-after-free in Chrome's XML component, already exploited in attacks, the eighth Chrome zero-day fixed this year.

item.title: Exploited: CISA Warns of Active Exploitation of OpenSSH, GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, and IBM Flaws
item.description: CISA added four flaws in GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, and IBM Aspera Faspex to its KEV catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation.

item.title: Exploited: Hackers now exploit critical Barracuda ESG flaws to gain root access
item.description: Barracuda warned that attackers are actively exploiting two recently patched Email Security Gateway flaws that allow commands to run with root privileges.

item.title: Exploited: Critical Xen Orchestra auth bypass flaw exploited to hijack VM servers
item.description: A critical authentication bypass in Xen Orchestra is being actively exploited, enabling administrator access and potential takeover of XCP-ng virtualization hosts.

item.title: Binance warns of iOS flaw that could leak crypto wallet secrets
item.description: Binance warns that an Apple iOS flaw in versions 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2 lets third-party apps read other apps' private files, including crypto seed phrases and credentials.

item.title: Exploited: Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,235 flaws, Outlook zero-day
item.description: Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes a record 1,235 flaws, including an actively exploited Outlook zero-day.

item.title: Exploited: SGLang RCE Exploit Breaches NEAR AI, Steals Data From 18 Agents and About 100 Users
item.description: Attackers exploited a remote code execution flaw in the open-source SGLang inference engine to run code on a NEAR AI inference server, potentially exposing confidential-mode requests.

item.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
item.description: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, where AI agents wrote three million lines of Lean proofs verifying Signal's core encryption.

item.title: llm-gemini 0.36
item.description: Simon Willison's llm-gemini 0.36 adds Gemini 4 Carbon, now generally available at $2/$10 per million tokens, rising to $4/$20 on December 1.

item.title: Long-horizon agents and durable execution
item.description: Martin Fowler's site publishes Kiran Prakash's explainer on durable execution, a pattern that logs completed external-facing steps so long-running agents can resume after crashes or failures.

item.title: How we rebuilt the Shopify app in 12 weeks
item.description: Shopify describes rebuilding its mobile app in 12 weeks, redesigning architecture, tooling and workflow around validation after agents began writing its mobile code.

item.title: How We Built TLX: A Hardware-Native GPU Compiler for Production ML at Scale
item.description: Meta describes TLX, a Triton extension adding explicit warp-group and cluster-level control for GPU kernels, reporting gains in RecSys and LLM pretraining workloads.

item.title: AI usage generates a fragile codebase
item.description: An essay argues that heavy AI coding tool usage produces fragile codebases; it drew 351 points and 386 comments on Hacker News.
